text: vignette introduces survival analysis RLT (Reinforcement Learning Trees). RLT survival forests estimate survival probabilities cumulative hazards given predictor values, return hazard increments observed failure-time grid. Key features include: Three split rules: logrank (default), suplogrank, coxgrad. Linear combination (LC) splits: combine multiple variables single split direction. Variance estimation: matched-sample U-statistic, infinitesimal jackknife (IJ), jackknife. Confidence bands: get.surv.band() provides naive smoothed simultaneous bands survival curves.
